source: docs/official/Pokemon Locations.xlsx, sheets 'Game Corner' and 'Other' (the R&B author's own workbook)
purpose: Where a Pokemon comes from when it does NOT come from grass.
The oracle modelled wild encounter tables and nothing else, so eight
badge-gated Game Corner rewards, three in-game trades, a starter egg,
Castform, Kubfu, the fossils and seven roaming legendaries were all
invisible. In a nuzlocke those are guaranteed Pokemon the catch advisor
gates: `opensAt` is a fight order on the same scale as availability.json: the
number of enemy Pokemon faced before that fight. A badge reward opens at
the order of the leader who hands the badge over.
The badge ORDER in the workbook matches this run map's fight orders
exactly, including R&B's swap of Brawly ahead of Roxanne. Two
independent sources agreeing on a non-obvious ordering is the reason
these dates are stated rather than estimated.
unknowns: CORRECTED 2026-09-20: the three gifts were recorded as 'named with no
location'. The workbook's 'Other' sheet DOES give one — its Gifts table is
Location | Pokemon, and the first transcription kept only the second
column. Lavaridge Town (starter egg), Weather Institute on Route 119
(Castform), Mossdeep City (Kubfu). The PLACES are the author's.
The DATES are derived, and deliberately late: the workbook gives no fight,
so each gift opens at the last fight that certainly precedes holding it.
A date that is too late costs a run some value; one that is too early
Not known, and not guessed: how many Game Corner prizes a run may take.
The workbook says each badge 'unlocks a new set' and the prize is random
within it. It does not say one prize per set or one in total. One player
record treats it as a single pull worth delaying all game for the Rain
operator ruling; the harness currently claims one PER BADGE.
The roaming legendaries are gated on 'the story event at Sootopolis
City' rather than a numbered fight, so they carry `after` prose and a
null order. Their routes ARE given and are recorded.

gameCorner.note: Each badge unlocks a new set. The Pokemon received is RANDOM between the options, so these are odds, not a choice.

gifts.note: Random among the three. An egg hatches at level 1 and is raised to the cap like any catch.

derived: after Gentleman Clifford & Macey (1125), the last fight before Leader Tate, whose gym is in Mossdeep. availability.json dates the city at 1183 by tracker interpolation, which is later than its own gym (1131) and so cannot be right.

fossils.note: One random fossil is available at Mirage Tower; every other fossil except Fossilized Drake and Fossilized Dino is at the Desert Underpass.
